title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN-SEPTEMBER 11th, Speaking in Tehran before his trip to India, President Masoud Pezeshkian said BRICS was formed to counter unilateralism, and that the bloc has adopted the slogan of solidarity, sustainability, resistance, and innovation for development.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN-SEPTEMBER 11th, Speaking in Tehran before his trip to India, President Masoud Pezeshkian said BRICS was formed to counter unilateralism, and that the bloc has adopted the slogan of solidarity, sustainability, resistance, and innovation for development."

""

"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:53): "The group that has actually formed within BRICS has 21 members, 11 of whom are the main BRICS members and 10 others who have been added, referred to as BRICS Plus. This group constitutes more than 45 percent of the world's population and 35 percent of the world's land. The goals here are essentially to fight unilateralism, and the effort is to enable countries to operate with their own independence. In this regard, the slogan they have chosen for this year's summit is solidarity, sustainability, resistance, and innovation.""

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(00:54 - 01:36): "It is supposed to hold discussions to resolve economic, financial, industrial, scientific, and commercial issues between various countries. Regarding monetary discussions, a dedicated bank has been established within BRICS, the New Development Bank (NDB). Through this bank, investments and joint activities can be carried out, with greater effort focused on enabling actions without dependence on the dollar, thereby fostering regional development. This also aims to combat the expansionist agenda currently pursued by the United States and its associated groups.""

"SOT3, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(01:37 - 02:26): "The summit is a very good opportunity for us to interact with the major countries present there, such as China, Russia, Brazil, and other regional countries, including India, which is hosting the 18th session of the summit. Our relations with India are very old, we share a long cultural history, and we can develop our commonalities on many issues together, culturally, economically, and socially. These are issues that will naturally be discussed in this session and in this upcoming opportunity with all these leaders, whether in private meetings or in general summits.""

"SOT4, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(02:27 - 03:04): "The reason for the formation of BRICS was to counter unilateralism, and the fact that they have now chosen the slogan of solidarity, stability, resistance, and innovation is aimed at enabling them to develop day by day. Of course, the world's economic issues are very complex, and the dominance that these powers have established in the world so far requires new programs and perspectives. Based on this innovation, the effort will be, God willing, to overcome this hegemonism and unilateralism.
